name: color-picker-for-code
description: Colour swatches and a visual colour picker for 0xRRGGBB and 0xRRGGBBAA hex literals in any language.

colorPickerForCode.enabled.description: Detect 0xRRGGBB / 0xRRGGBBAA literals and show colour swatches and the colour picker for them.

enumDescriptions: 8-digit values are 0xRRGGBBAA (alpha is the last byte, as in CSS #RRGGBBAA).
8-digit values are 0xAARRGGBB (alpha is the first byte, as in Android, Flutter and .NET).
colorPickerForCode.alphaPosition.description: Where the alpha byte sits in 8-digit hex literals.

enumDescriptions: Match the literal being edited (upper-case when it has no letters to go by).
Always write A-F in upper case.
Always write a-f in lower case.
colorPickerForCode.letterCase.description: Letter case of the hex digits written by the colour picker.

colorPickerForCode.excludedLanguages.markdownDescription: Language identifiers (for example `plaintext` or `log`) in which 0x colour literals are *not* detected.
